comment: GraphQL requests gh 2.46.0 sent as the first request of each command, captured with GH_DEBUG=api through a proxy that refused the connection. Only a command whose first request is GraphQL appears, and later requests of the same command are missing.

requests.query: query RepositoryReleaseList($direction:OrderDirection!$endCursor:String$name:String!$owner:String!$perPage:Int!){repository(owner: $owner, name: $name){releases(first: $perPage, orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: $direction}, after: $endCursor){nodes{name,tagName,isDraft,isLatest,isPrerelease,createdAt,publishedAt},pageInfo{hasNextPage,endCursor}}}}
